The dummy data object need not have positive rank at a particular invocation; this does not admit an ordinary scalar pointer declaration.

PDF123 lines20-38: seven positive routes, with all seven conjuncts of the nonzero-section route retained. Failure of a positive premise does not by itself imply noncontiguity.
This route specifies an array allocated by an ALLOCATE statement, not an inferred rule for every possible allocation event.
An actual vector-subscript is distinct from9.5.3.2's multiple-subscript/triplet notation and its expansion rules.

Original physical PDF124, printed110, line1 leaves every other object's contiguity processor dependent. This classification is not a portable true/false oracle or a no-op Boolean test.

Do not declare all zero/singleton cases equivalent.

One nonzero component does not prove absence of padding; other zero-sized components do not establish an object byte size.

No address arithmetic, sizeof analogue, C-layout model or performance test is supplied by this explanatory note.
Original NOTE2 on PDF124 explains possible optimization use and gives two declarations, not an optimization or runtime-copy obligation.
The attribute can help optimizations, but neither a required pass nor timing, memory-traffic or speedup behavior is specified here.
SPTR(:) is an eligible array pointer; its declaration does not establish association or make an unassociated pointer a valid IS_CONTIGUOUS argument.
D(:,:) needs a complete assumed-shape dummy/interface context. It is not an ordinary local array merely made valid by CONTIGUOUS.
Original NOTE3 on PDF124 distinguishes assumed-shape/rank dummy contiguity from any requirement for the actual to be contiguous. It is not a general statement about pointer dummies.
The two stated dummy categories retain their separate association and inquiry rules.
The CONTIGUOUS attribute belongs to the dummy; no implicit transfer of that attribute to the actual argument is inferred.
A noncontiguous actual can be permitted, but VALUE, vector-subscript, ASYNCHRONOUS/VOLATILE, coarray and type/rank restrictions remain independently applicable.
The analogy does not add explicit-shape/assumed-size arrays to C830's attribute-eligibility list.

requirements.title: CONTIGUOUS has three eligible entity categories
requirements.definition: An entity with CONTIGUOUS is an array pointer, an assumed-shape array or an assumed-rank dummy data object. An object being actually contiguous does not by itself make it eligible for the attribute. The assumed-rank category can have a scalar effective argument; an ordinary fixed-rank scalar pointer is not that category.
requirements.oracle: Fourteen complete compile/f2023 program units represent eight C830 facets. Five negatives give CONTIGUOUS to an ordinary scalar, scalar pointer, ordinary explicit-shape array, fixed-rank deferred-shape ALLOCATABLE array, or nonpointer assumed-size dummy. Each control deletes only ', contiguous', preserving every other byte and the actual entity category. Four additional admissions declare an array pointer and explicit-interface assumed-shape, ordinary assumed-rank and ALLOCATABLE assumed-rank dummies. A negative needs the actual located CONTIGUOUS/entity-category cause in the actual staged input, matching one complete extracted diagnostic message. The four ordinary declarations retain their line3 anchor. The assumed-size dummy has primary declaration line6 and additional procedure-header line4 as separate subject anchors; gap line5 and cross-anchor ranges do not qualify. An ordinary zero or nonzero reporting status can satisfy that capability. Only the exact observed Flang portability message is an allowed nonfatal report. Every valid case requires successful object compilation and is positive-control evidence, not a runtime effect.
requirements.oracle_limitation: The assumed-size pair preserves the original complete module/procedure source and its CONTIGUOUS-only repair. Its declaration/header relation uses the independently reviewed disjoint-anchor infrastructure from batch048, not a broadened span, coalesced statements or a false GNU conformance failure for selecting the header. Source, fixture and processor adjudications remain separate from representing that relation. This finite eligibility matrix is not an enumeration of all possible declarations, actual arguments or processor modes. Ordinary fixed-rank exclusions do not ban eligible assumed-rank dummies, and actual whole-array contiguity does not authorize the attribute. Module-contained procedures supply explicit interfaces without requiring any unavailable payload, allocation or pointer-association inquiry. No initializer, DATA, SAVE, coarray, C companion, user-defined type, argument call, pointer assignment or runtime observer is present. All four S-owned contiguity requirements, residual processor choices and canonical component/source-use owners remain separate. No fatal exit, printed rule code or prescribed English text is required. Exact finite message alternatives are qualification predicates, not standardized wording. Quoted examples inside another error and foreign paths sharing the source basename cannot supply this cause or source identity. Source echoes, bare attribute words, unrelated shape/type/kind failures, unsupported facilities, Internal/ASR/verifier, timeout/crash/resource failures and wrong-source reports do not count. Generation preserves independent source, case, link, SourceUses and inventory adjudications; it neither approves them nor relabels earlier compiler observations.

requirements.title: Eligible CONTIGUOUS dummies have a contiguous view
requirements.source: 8.5.7 p1 assumed-shape and assumed-rank clauses, physical PDF123, lines18-19
requirements.definition: The CONTIGUOUS attribute makes an assumed-shape array or assumed-rank dummy data object contiguous. A permitted actual argument need not itself be contiguous. The source defines the dummy's property, not a particular copying, allocation, address or optimization mechanism.

pending.contiguous-actual-control: PENDING source/case relation to C715_valid__contiguous and a fully typed INTEGER assumed-shape control with a defined whole-array actual. Preserve the existing run/positive-control role and original C715 owner; keyword recognition is not a newly executed local effect.
pending.scalar-assumed-rank-boundary: PENDING source/admission context with a scalar effective argument and eligible CONTIGUOUS assumed-rank dummy. IS_CONTIGUOUS is permitted there and returns true for rank0 by16.9.115, even without relying on the attribute; that result alone cannot prove the local attribute effect. An ordinary scalar actual directly passed to IS_CONTIGUOUS is a different, ineligible argument form.
pending.argument-interface-source-use: PENDING finite canonical type/kind/rank, definability, vector-subscript, VALUE and C1548/C1549 constraints, plus the distinct C1550 pointer-dummy rule. Source NOTE3 is not permission to ignore them. Preserve procedure interfaces and all original owners before linking evidence.

requirements.oracle: Two complete run/effect/f2023 programs implement only strided-actual-assumed-shape and strided-actual-assumed-rank. Main defines an ordinary INTEGER a(4) by the executable assignment a=[11,12,13,14] and passes only the definable nonvector section a(1:4:2) through a complete internal procedure interface to a CONTIGUOUS INTENT(INOUT) dummy. Direct IS_CONTIGUOUS(x) is compared with literal true, and actual dummy RANK/SIZE are checked against1/2. The ordinary assumed-shape case checks x(1:2) values11/13 separately, adds10 to each, and checks21/23. The assumed-rank case uses property inquiries on x as permitted by C840, then SELECT RANK(r=>x), RANK(1), for every payload read/write. The default branch ERROR STOPs. Main independently checks all four returned values21/12/23/14, so untouched elements and updates are both consumed. Entry, update, normal procedure-completion, rank-branch and guard-count observations plus exact completion stdout, empty stderr and normal exit0 reject missing calls, updates and no-op/early-success paths. Every contiguity, rank, size, value, event, check-total and output assertion has an exact one-span full-program wrong-oracle probe, qualified only when the unchanged current parent passes and the intended runtime guard/output mismatch occurs.
requirements.oracle_limitation: Other S8.5.7-001 facets are outside this generator's coverage, and C830 plus the other S requirements retain their supplied source, fields, pending states and ownership. Both programs are effects; no control-role opt-in or C715 control reuse is supplied. The actual is a nonvector INTEGER triplet section with defined elements, no ASYNCHRONOUS, VOLATILE, POINTER, ALLOCATABLE, coarray, VALUE or overlapping dummy actuals. Matching default-INTEGER type/kind/rank and definability/explicit-interface conditions are preserved. The C1548/C1549 antecedents do not apply; the source's dummy guarantee does not assert that the caller has CONTIGUOUS. No optional actual-section contiguity inquiry, pointer assignment, fixed-rank observer temporary or RANK constructor appears. The rank-one associate designates the actual dummy, not a separate destination. No copying count, temporary/address, ABI, storage-stride or allocation mechanism is observed or required. Complete source and literal truth precede compiler calibration. Build/unsupported/resource/runtime failures remain real; failed parents and compile rejections do not qualify sensitivity. ERROR STOP token/status observations are empirical guard evidence, not mandatory printed rule codes or a numeric termination policy. Source, fixture, mode-qualified observations and inventory approval remain independent; no source-use, canonical-link, review or baseline record is renewed.

requirements.title: A CONTIGUOUS array pointer is associated only with a contiguous target
requirements.source: 8.5.7 p1 pointer clause, physical PDF123, lines18-19
requirements.definition: When an array pointer has CONTIGUOUS, a target with which it is pointer associated is contiguous. The attribute does not establish association, require an associated target at all times, or make arbitrary targets contiguous. Ordinary pointer assignment requires actual contiguity here; the stronger simply-contiguous conditions in other contexts retain their own owners.

pending.whole-target-admission: PENDING a live defined INTEGER TARGET array and a CONTIGUOUS pointer associated with the whole compatible array. Check association state before IS_CONTIGUOUS/value use, and retain type/kind/rank/parameter and lifetime premises. No address comparison or initial association is inferred from the pointer declaration.
pending.actual-not-simple-target: PENDING ordinary pointer assignment to a nonzero target section1:4:1 that meets every8.5.7p2(7) condition. Its explicit stride prevents simply-contiguous syntax under9.5.4 even though actual contiguity is guaranteed. Keep this distinct from pointer-dummy argument and bounds-remapping restrictions; no vector target.
pending.noncontiguous-target-policy: PENDING source-only CONTIGUOUS-pointer assignment to a definite two-element gapped INTEGER target section, repaired only by removal of CONTIGUOUS while keeping valid ordinary pointer association. Do not instantiate a rejection case unless a separate, explicit diagnostic policy is approved; without it retain only the source relation. No policy is authored here. Do not execute the nonconforming assignment, demand a runtime trap, or invent mandatory prose diagnostics.
pending.initialization-owner-source-use: PENDING exact canonical C769_invalid__initialization_strided, its repair and C769_valid__initialization_contiguous source relationships. Initialization compatibility and C770 static-target requirements are distinct from ordinary pointer assignment. Preserve inputs, IDs, roles and report contracts; do not clone them under this S ID.
pending.pointer-dummy-simple-source-use: PENDING canonical C1550 contrast: an associated array pointer without CONTIGUOUS can have an actually contiguous target but is not a simply-contiguous object-name. A correct CONTIGUOUS pointer-dummy actual needs the exact9.5.4/C1550 premise and full association rules. Adding CONTIGUOUS to that actual is a candidate repair only when its existing target is genuinely contiguous; rank-one bounds-remapping permission does not waive pointer-target contiguity.

requirements.oracle: Complete pointer/target source relations with valid admissions and policy-gated nonconforming contrasts. Required initialization or pointer-dummy diagnostics retain C769/C812/C1550 rather than being relabelled as a universal local prose report.
requirements.oracle_limitation: IS_CONTIGUOUS of a pointer requires association even when its attribute is known. Do not inquire on a disassociated/undefined pointer, inspect a target after return/deallocation, substitute an invalid vector target or rely on temporary addresses. No new policy or header/representation assumption.

requirements.title: The seven stated routes guarantee actual contiguity
requirements.source: 8.5.7 p2 and list, physical PDF123, lines20-38
requirements.definition: Contiguity is guaranteed for an object with CONTIGUOUS; a nonpointer whole array that is not assumed-shape; an assumed-shape array associated with a contiguous actual; an assumed-rank dummy with a contiguous effective argument; an array allocated by an ALLOCATE statement; or a pointer associated with a contiguous target. A nonzero-size array section is also contiguous when its base is contiguous, it has no vector subscript, selected elements retain base array-element order with no interleaved excluded elements, any CHARACTER substring includes the whole parent string, only the final part-ref has nonzero rank, and it is not an array complex-part designator.

pending.stride-and-singleton-boundary: PENDING a(1:4:1) of a(4) and singleton a(2:2:7), each nonzero-size and satisfying the full positive conjunction. Both are actually contiguous; an explicit stride is nevertheless excluded by the simply-contiguous triplet syntax. Empty sections and unresolved singleton/vector/substring forms stay under p4 unless another normative route resolves them.
pending.vector-and-multiple-subscript-source-use: PENDING exact R925 vector-subscript versus R920/R923 multiple-subscript/triplet expansion. A vector fails the positive section route, not automatically the whole contiguity decision. Consecutive-vector and expanded-triplet cases require their own full p2/p3 classification; no parenthesis/bracket or array-value proxy.
pending.ranked-part-and-complex-source-use: PENDING whole nonpointer array-component classification under9.5.2 separately from sections of scalar-parent components, earlier-ranked array-of-structure selections and complex%RE/%IM arrays. For a section, prove base contiguity and every ordering/ranked-part predicate; do not turn failure of p2(f)/(g) into an automatic false result or infer padding.

requirements.oracle:
Eight complete run/effect/f2023 programs discharge eight S8.5.7-003 facets. Each program uses direct IS_CONTIGUOUS on the actual designator named by a complete p2 route and expects literal true: a CONTIGUOUS associated array pointer, a nonpointer explicit-shape whole array, an assumed-shape dummy associated with a contiguous whole-array actual, arrays allocated by ALLOCATE statements (ordinary allocatable nonzero, ordinary allocatable zero-size, and allocated pointer target), a non-CONTIGUOUS pointer associated with a contiguous whole target, a gap-free INTEGER section, a multi-dimensional section taking full leading dimensions, and a full-length CHARACTER substring array section. Every fixture also checks hand-computed bounds, shape, and nonzero INTEGER or CHARACTER payload values that are independent of the contiguity inquiry. Feature mutations replace the inquired expression with a p3 nonconsecutive array subobject; the character full-substring fixture uses a same-program INTEGER p3 sentinel so the mutation is not weakened by processor latitude for residual character-section handling. Each mutated complete program fails before printing the completion line.

Batch296 S8.5.7-003 assumed-rank route: Batch296 adds one S8.5.7-003 run for assumed-rank-contiguous-effective. A whole explicit-shape INTEGER array with shape [2,3] is passed to a non-CONTIGUOUS assumed-rank dummy. Direct IS_CONTIGUOUS(x), RANK(x), SIZE(x) and SELECT RANK payload checks establish that the dummy's effective argument is a contiguous whole array. The feature mutation changes only the actual argument to a gapped nonvector section a(1:2:1,1:3:2), which remains a conforming call but makes the literal contiguity assertion fail on the reference compiler.
requirements.oracle_limitation:
The selected p2 cases establish only the standard-required result of IS_CONTIGUOUS and ordinary bounds/shape/value preservation for the finite designators present in the sources. They do not measure addresses, storage stride, allocation layout, copy creation, temporaries, timing, padding, or optimization. The assumed-rank, explicit-stride singleton, vector/multiple-subscript and ranked-part/complex source-use facets remain pending. A missing positive route is never interpreted as false; false expectations belong only to the two separately selected S8.5.7-004 fixtures. The zero-size allocated object is queried only for ALLOCATED, IS_CONTIGUOUS and SHAPE, never for payload.

Batch296 S8.5.7-003 assumed-rank limits: Only the positive p2 assumed-rank/effective-argument route is covered. No CONTIGUOUS attribute, copy strategy, address, stride, temporary, vector-subscript, singleton, complex-part or residual processor-dependent case is asserted. Frozen LFortran currently ICEs on this valid assumed-rank IS_CONTIGUOUS inquiry; the reference compiler passes.

requirements.title: The stated array-subobject conjunction guarantees noncontiguity
requirements.source: 8.5.7 p3 and bullets, physical PDF123, lines39-44
requirements.definition: An array subobject is not contiguous when it has at least two elements, those elements in array-element order are not consecutive among the base object's elements, it is not zero-length CHARACTER, and it is not of a derived type whose only ultimate components are zero-size arrays or zero-length characters. All predicates are required. This is a valid-object property, not a language prohibition on noncontiguous arrays.

pending.nonconsecutive-vector-gate: PENDING source-qualified direct array-subobject a([1,3]) inquiry, distinguishing the vector-designated object from an ordinary procedure dummy/temporary view. Establish all p3 predicates and exact intrinsic actual-argument semantics before fixing the executable oracle; never infer every vector-subscripted section is false merely because p2 excludes vectors.
pending.cardinality-boundaries: PENDING finite zero-, one- and two-element section source map. The two-or-more premise excludes zero/singleton from this negative route; singleton sections may satisfy the positive p2 route, while other cases can remain processor dependent. Do not impose a universal size<=1, abs(stride)==1 or empty-section Boolean rule.
pending.zero-storage-type-exceptions: PENDING exact zero-length CHARACTER and derived types whose only ultimate components are zero-size arrays/zero-length characters. Their gapped sections are excluded from this negative rule; that exclusion alone does not prove true. Whole-array or other positive routes remain separately applicable. No guessed byte size, padding or ABI layout.
pending.ordered-reversal-source-use: PENDING original9.5.3.3 element-order interpretation for reversed traversals and distinct scalar/triplet/multiple-subscript forms. Confirm ordered consecutiveness for each finite candidate before an oracle; no generic negative-stride or adjacent-address assertion.

requirements.oracle: Two complete run/effect/f2023 programs discharge ordinary-gapped-section and multidimensional-interleaving for S8.5.7-004. Each false expectation is paired in the same program with a p2 positive control on the same base object, so a default logical false or skipped inquiry cannot satisfy the case. The one-dimensional case inquires a(-3:3:2), whose at-least-two selected elements are not consecutive in the base object's element order. The two-dimensional case inquires a(1:2,5:6) from a(1:3,5:7), whose selected element order contains interleaved excluded base elements. Hand-computed bounds, shape and nonzero payload values prove the intended valid subobjects are used. Feature mutations corrupt the positive control designator to the same nonconsecutive form while retaining its literal true oracle, and wrong-false reverse mutations change the required false to true; both classes fail in execution.
requirements.oracle_limitation: These negative fixtures use only ordinary INTEGER array subobjects satisfying the complete p3 conjunction. They do not generalize to zero-size, singleton, zero-length CHARACTER, zero-storage derived-type, vector-subscript, reversed-order, partial-substring, complex-part or padding-dependent objects, all of which remain pending or processor dependent unless another source route resolves them. No diagnostic, trap, address, hidden-copy or performance behavior is required.
